This property specifies the BIOS time that needs to be set. The BIOS time is the time that is stored in the computer's Basic Input/Output System (BIOS) and is used to keep track of the current time and date. The BIOS time is set in the format YYYY-MM-DDTHH:MM:SS+-HH:MM

This property specifies whether Daylight Saving Time (DST) is enabled or not. DST is the practice of temporarily advancing clocks during the summer months by one hour so that people can make the most of the sunlight during their waking hours.
